author: Frivaldszky, 1838
habitat: 인가 부근의 성긴 숲, 대나무 숲, 건물 주변의 나무
summary: 인가 근처의 성긴 숲이나 대나무 숲, 건물 주변 나무에 사는 비둘기로, 서해 섬과 홍도 등 우리나라 전역에서 산다. 소나무, 삼나무, 대나무 위나 건물에서 튀어나온 선반 같은 곳에 둥지를 틀고, 3~7월에 한배에 알 2개를 낳는다. 식물의 씨와 열매를 즐겨 먹고 사람이 버린 빵 부스러기, 채소, 딸기류, 벚나무 열매, 일부 무척추동물과 곤충도 먹는다. 세계적으로는 서유럽에서 동아시아에 이르는 유라시아의 넓은 지역에서 번식한다.

art.subject: Eurasian Collared Dove (Streptopelia decaocto), adult: head, neck and breast pale pinkish grey-buff, the forehead and crown slightly greyer; a narrow black half-collar across the hindneck, edged white; back and inner wing coverts sandy grey-brown, the outer coverts paler blue-grey; primaries dark brown; belly pale grey; lower rump and undertail coverts bluish-grey; tail grey-brown above with broad whitish tips to the outer feathers; bill slender, dull black; iris dark red with a narrow pale eye-ring; legs dark pinkish-red.
art.pose: perched on a bamboo stem, side view
art.scene: edge of a Korean village: sparse woodland and a bamboo grove; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched: pale pinkish grey-buff head and breast, black half-collar edged white on the hindneck, sandy grey-brown upperparts, dark primaries, slender dull black bill, red legs
adult, perched seen from below: rosy grey breast and belly, bluish-grey undertail coverts, tail underside blackish at the base with a broad white outer half
art.build: Medium-sized, slender dove, about 33cm, a little smaller and much slimmer than a feral pigeon, with a small rounded head, short neck and long tail. Bill short and slender, much shorter than the head. Legs short, red. At rest the folded wings reach only about the middle of the tail. Tail long, square-ended to slightly rounded; from below the basal half is blackish and the outer half broadly white. In flight pale grey outer wing coverts contrast with dark primaries.
avoid: Do not paint scaly rufous-and-black wing coverts or striped patches on the sides of the neck; that is Oriental Turtle Dove (Streptopelia orientalis).
Do not paint a white-spotted black neck patch; that is Spotted Dove (Spilopelia chinensis).
Do not paint wine-red upperparts or a short tail; that is Red Collared Dove (Streptopelia tranquebarica).
Do not omit the black half-collar on the hindneck.
